title: The Beauty Of Change
summary:
Hello dear souls,
we created a new song " The Beauty Of Change "
For all of you from our hearts.
Haleen 🫶

Under a new sky
No more resistance
A courageous leap to go deep
Set it free

Let go of the line
It's time to unfold
Pure Love untamed
In the book of life
A fresh new page named
The beauty of change
In the book of life
A fresh new page named
The beauty of change

Know why and no shy
No need to hide
A courageous leap to go deep
Set it free

from Seeded, released March 24, 2023
Composer - Hans De Bruck - Kathleen Merckx
Lyrics - Kathleen Merckx - Hans De Bruck
